```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
# params <- list()
# params$config <- "E:/Projects/MP_workshop/peaktable/PL_LIPS_PASEF/config.yml"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

is_blank <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x)) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[1])))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(isTRUE(x))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(!is.na(x[1]) && x[1] != 0)
  if (is.character(x)) return(tolower(trimws(x[1])) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "y", "yes"))
  FALSE
}

require_cfg <- function(cfg, name) {
  val <- cfg[[name]]
  if (is_blank(val)) stop("Missing required config field: ", name)
  val
}

add_missing_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    for (m in missing) df[[m]] <- NA
  }
  df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}

convert_mode_output <- function(path_peaktable, path_peaktable_out, path_peaktable_istd_out, cols_to_save, df_temp) {
  if (!file.exists(path_peaktable)) {
    stop("Input mzMine peaktable not found: ", path_peaktable)
  }

  raw <- read.csv(path_peaktable, sep = ";", header = TRUE, check.names = TRUE)

  raw_features <-
    plyr::rbind.fill(df_temp, raw) %>%
    add_missing_cols(cols_to_save) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      spectral_similarity = spectral_db_matches.similarity_score,
      iin_id = ion_identities.iin_id,
      ion_identities = ion_identities.ion_identities
    )

  raw_features[is.na(raw_features) | raw_features == ""] <- NA

  features <-
    raw_features %>%
    mutate(
      identity = coalesce(compound_db_identity.compound_name, lipid_annotations.lipid_annotations, spectral_db_matches.compound_name),
      ion = coalesce(compound_db_identity.adduct, lipid_annotations.ion_adduct, spectral_db_matches.ion_adduct, ion_identities),
      formula = coalesce(compound_db_identity.mol_formula, lipid_annotations.mol_formula, spectral_db_matches.mol_formula, ion_identities.simple_formulas),
      mz_diff_ppm = coalesce(compound_db_identity.mz_diff_ppm, lipid_annotations.mz_diff_ppm, spectral_db_matches.mz_diff_ppm),
      rt_diff = compound_db_identity.rt_absolute_error,
      identity_source = ifelse(
        !is.na(compound_db_identity.compound_name), "In house library",
        ifelse(!is.na(lipid_annotations.lipid_annotations), "Lipid annotations",
               ifelse(!is.na(spectral_db_matches.compound_name), "Spectral library", NA))
      )
    ) %>%
    relocate(c(id, mz, rt, ccs, identity, ion, formula, mz_diff_ppm, rt_diff, identity_source, spectral_similarity, iin_id, ion_identities), .before = 0)

  sample_index <- grepl("^datafile\\.", colnames(raw))
  area_index <- grepl("\\.area$", colnames(raw))
  peaks <- raw[, (sample_index & area_index), drop = FALSE]
  names(peaks) <- gsub("^datafile\\.", "", names(peaks))
  names(peaks) <- gsub("\\.area$", "", names(peaks))

  peaktable <- cbind(features, peaks)
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(peaktable, file = path_peaktable_out)

  row_index <- !is.na(features$formula) & grepl("'", features$formula, fixed = TRUE)
  rt_index <- grepl("\\.rt$", colnames(raw))
  mz_index <- grepl("\\.mz$", colnames(raw))

  features_istd <- features[row_index, , drop = FALSE]
  peaks_istd <- raw[row_index, (sample_index & (mz_index | rt_index | area_index)), drop = FALSE]
  peaktable_istd <- cbind(features_istd, peaks_istd)

  openxlsx::write.xlsx(peaktable_istd, file = path_peaktable_istd_out)

  list(
    peaktable_path = path_peaktable_out,
    peaktable_istd_path = path_peaktable_istd_out,
    n_features = nrow(features),
    n_istd = nrow(features_istd)
  )
}

```

```{r pipeline input, include = FALSE}

if (is_blank(params$config)) {
  stop("params$config is required")
}
if (!file.exists(params$config)) {
  stop("Config file does not exist: ", params$config)
}

config <- read_yaml(params$config)
if (is.null(config) || !is.list(config)) {
  stop("Invalid YAML config: expected a named list")
}

run.pos = as_flag(config$run.pos)
run.neg = as_flag(config$run.neg)
mzmine_peaktable_pos <- require_cfg(config, "mzmine_peaktable_pos")
mzmine_peaktable_neg <- require_cfg(config, "mzmine_peaktable_neg")

# output
path_peaktable_pos <- require_cfg(config, "path_peaktable_pos")
path_peaktable_neg <- require_cfg(config, "path_peaktable_neg")
path_peaktable_istd_pos <- require_cfg(config, "path_peaktable_istd_pos")
path_peaktable_istd_neg <- require_cfg(config, "path_peaktable_istd_neg")

for (out_path in c(path_peaktable_pos, path_peaktable_neg, path_peaktable_istd_pos, path_peaktable_istd_neg)) {
  out_dir <- dirname(out_path)
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
  
```

# Convert output
```{r}

cols_to_save <- 
  c("id", "mz", "rt", "ccs", 
         "compound_db_identity.compound_name", "compound_db_identity.mz_diff_ppm", "compound_db_identity.rt_absolute_error", "compound_db_identity.adduct", "compound_db_identity.mol_formula", 
         "spectral_db_matches.compound_name", "spectral_db_matches.mz_diff_ppm", "spectral_db_matches.similarity_score", "spectral_db_matches.ion_adduct", "spectral_db_matches.mol_formula",
         "lipid_annotations.lipid_annotations", "lipid_annotations.mz_diff_ppm", "lipid_annotations.ion_adduct", "lipid_annotations.mol_formula", 
         "ion_identities.iin_id", "ion_identities.ion_identities", "ion_identities.simple_formulas")

df_temp <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(cols_to_save), nrow = 0))
colnames(df_temp) <- cols_to_save
```

## Positive
```{r, eval = run.pos}

result_pos <- convert_mode_output(
  path_peaktable = mzmine_peaktable_pos,
  path_peaktable_out = path_peaktable_pos,
  path_peaktable_istd_out = path_peaktable_istd_pos,
  cols_to_save = cols_to_save,
  df_temp = df_temp
)

```

### Peaks
```{r, eval = run.pos}

cat("Converted peaktable is stored in: \n")
cat(result_pos$peaktable_path, "\n")
cat("Number of converted features: ", result_pos$n_features, "\n")

```
